en.headline: Victoria Park lantern displays stay up until 4 October
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department has extended the Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival by a week after large crowds during the festival.
body: Lanterns at Victoria Park will remain on show until 4 October after the Leisure and Cultural Services Department extended the Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival 2026 by one week.

The department said the extra week was arranged because of the large number of visitors and the public response during the festival period. Lighting hours were also stretched to midnight from 24 to 27 September.

This year’s carnival, themed “A Delightful Journey through the Lantern Garden”, includes lanterns of local foods, a corridor of heart-shaped arches showing everyday Hong Kong scenes, and paper-craft displays of rabbits with a giant moon. The Hong Kong Tourism Board has presented “Shadowlight”, a large Qinhuai lantern from Nanjing.

A creative market, fire-dragon dances, handicraft demonstrations and self-service lantern riddles have also been part of the programme. The department said the extension is intended to give residents and visitors more time to see the displays ahead of the National Day holiday.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈展延長至10月4日
zh.dek: 康文署因應人流眾多，把維多利亞公園中秋綵燈嘉年華延長一周至10月4日。
body: 維多利亞公園的綵燈將展出至10月4日。康樂及文化事務署因應中秋期間人流眾多及迴響熱烈，把2026年中秋綵燈嘉年華延長一周。
署方表示，延長安排是為讓更多市民及旅客欣賞綵燈。9月24日至27日的亮燈時間亦曾延長至午夜12時。
本屆嘉年華以「綵燈庭園樂遊遊」為主題，展出本地美食造型花燈、以香港日常場景為題的心形拱門長廊，以及玉兔抱巨月等非遺紙絞燈飾。旅發局亦帶來南京秦淮大型燈組「影光」。
活動期間亦設中秋創意市集、舞火龍、傳統手工示範及自助燈謎。署方指延長展期，方便市民及旅客在國慶假期前繼續入場觀賞。
